issue.title: Check-run failure triage attaches no possible owners on athena, even for exact node_id matches

task_type_fields.impact: Plan sase-18j.10 (closed 2026-09-26) was meant to make owner matching work and prove it on athena, but in practice the triage footer almost never names the owning task bead. Consequences: a reopened deterministic failure (sase-13p) is labeled NEW with no owner, so agents are invited to treat it as their own regression; agents spend audited duplicate-triage reads (sase-14o, sase-1fy and sase-10d each drew 9-13 read-by checks) and +1s to rediscover owners the ledger already has; and KNOWN failures without owners are left without the pointer that would route them to the existing fix.
task_type_fields.repro:
Observed on athena while auditing task beads (lead research, 2026-10-07):

1. `sase tool runs -t check -n 1000 -j`, then `sase tool show -j <run>` for every check run created 2026-10-05T16:25Z..2026-10-07T16:25Z (117 runs: 111 failed, 6 signaled).
2. Across all 897 triage items in those runs, `label.possible_owners` is empty for every item, including failures whose open task bead's `node_id` names exactly the same file as the item's `locator_paths`:
   - `tests/ace/tui/test_app_import_budget.py::test_tui_app_import_stays_under_startup_budget` (15 runs; owner sase-13p; classified `new` in 7, `known` in 8)
   - `tests/tool/test_demand_runs.py::test_foreground_run_records_context_usage_and_grant` (4 runs; owner sase-1f0)
   - `tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_block_spread_pilot.py::test_block_spread_bracket_top_aligns` (2 runs; owner sase-1br)
   - symvision `_runs` findings (65 runs; owner sase-1h6, whose node_id is a stage label, so it may need a different locator)
3. Run diagnostics: 29/117 `triage owner candidates timed out`, 5/117 `bead store unavailable for owner candidates`; the other 83 runs gathered candidates and still matched none.
4. Calling `gather_owner_candidates(Path('.'))` directly in a workspace returns 327 candidates in ~0.75 s, including sase-13p/sase-1f0/sase-1br with the right `location`, so the input side works and the loss is in settle/matching (the core matcher behind `tool_run_triage_settle`) or in the timeout path.
5. `sase tool failures -d 14 -j -n 1000`: only 3 of ~1000 signature groups have non-empty `newest_owners` (the last was a sase-1fy location match on 2026-10-04).

issue.creation_reason: Found during the 48h task-bead impact audit: zero of 897 check-run triage items had possible owners even when an open ci/flake bead names the exact failing node, so the triage owner feature that sase-18j.10 shipped is effectively not working on athena.
